//UpdateReleasesUrl: Release feed for the auto-updater. Pre-releases count, drafts do not. When GitHub is unreachable the updater falls back to ApiBaseUrl and reads the version out of SHA256SUMS.txt. Empty disables the GitHub source.
//GeoUrls: Rule files for geo routing, from the release branch of each fork — the branch is force-pushed on every build, so the URL never changes. The .sha256sum sidecar beside each file is mandatory; nothing installs without one. Empty on both disables geo routing.
//BlockedPackages: Android packages that always bypass the tunnel, in every split-tunnel mode. Shown to the user read-only.
